description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including converting Oracle BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea.
tasks.reason: Azure Database for PostgreSQL provides the managed, cloud-native relational database service selected for the application's migration to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents and migrate the schema and photo data storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure database authentication to use Managed Identity instead of plaintext credentials.
